name: theluckystrike/mcp-currency
description: Live and historical exchange rates from the European Central Bank, in your AI chat: convert amounts, read rate history, and hand invoice tools the FX rates they need. No API key for the rates, cached locally, works offline. Also hosted remotely at https://mcp.zovo.one/mcp/currency; a free token from https://mcp.zovo.one/mcp/connect is required.
